about: Pincourt is a city on Île Perrot in Montérégie, west of the Island of Montréal toward Vaudreuil-Dorion and the Ottawa River–Lake Saint-Louis junction. Suburban neighbourhoods, local parks, and bridge links to the West Island define a riverside off-island community. About 15,000 people live in Pincourt.
